Name: Buford
Dialog: (looking at the Danville Cinemas website on his tablet) All right, let's see what's playin'.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: A movie day! What an off-brand approach to our afternoon.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah, I've been in the mood for a rom-com.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (takes the tablet) Ooh, what about a western?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Ugh! A western?

Name: Buford
Dialog: What do you got against westerns?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Aside from the hack storytelling, they're just a sea of sepia tone and spittoons.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I'll bet you a fried pickle I can change your perspective!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: First, I do not like fried pickles. And secondly, you can never change my perspective.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Can too!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Can not!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, I guess I know what we're gonna do today. Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P, Doofenshmirtz is at the Almond Brittle Convention, so you have the day off. I'm in nearby Swampville teaching Carl the manly art of piloting a fan boat.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Very manly, sir. Did I mention I'm allergic to bug bites? Maybe we should turn back.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Wait! "Deadly rapids ahead"? Carl, slow down!

Name: Carl
Dialog: I can't, sir! Rapids are fast! That's actually what "rapid" means!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Don't you argue semantics with me!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Mayday! Mayday! (static) Use your monotreme instincts to find us! Whoa! (static)

Name: Carl
Dialog: Bring mosquito repellent!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeehaw!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Are we lost, sir?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Pretty sure there's a small town half a klick north. Or is it south? Eh, it probably doesn't matter. Just try to keep up.

Name: Carl
Dialog: I think I'm stuck!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Put your back into it, Carl! (He wades forward but faceplants into the quagmire.) Not one word.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Are we gonna die, sir?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: We're going to be fine. In dire situations, you must rely on your manly man instincts. Now follow me.

Name: Major Monogram's voice
Dialog: Manly platypus.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (reading banner) "Forced Perspective Western Town".

Name: Phineas
Dialog: This is gonna help us change your perspective on westerns. Ferb, a demonstration, please. Depending on the position you're in, the varying size proportions trick the brain into seeing a different scale. Ready, Isabella?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Yippee-ki-yay!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You see, the second hat was much bigger. But it was further away!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: How is this gonna change my perspective on western cinema?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Perhaps a heartfelt ditty will clarify that for ya. Hit it!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah, I don't really get how it works either.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's best not to think about it too hard.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Whatever. (to Baljeet) Have you come around yet to appreciate the rustic beauty of the Wild West?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: While this Forced Perspective Town is charming, it has not changed my perspective. I still find the Western film genre tacky and— (screams as a giant tumbleweed runs him over)

Name: Hillbilly
Dialog: (Cajun accent) Hot biscuits! Looks like Ah snagged me one o' them teal-tailed city ducks or ma name ain't Bubba Doofenshmirtz! And ya know it is. It is. Mmm-mmm! Ah'mma make me some city ducks stew, starrin' you!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Sir, I don't think our instincts can get us out of this one.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, don't be a stick in the mud, Carl.

Name: Carl
Dialog: I'm not a stick, sir! I'm a person in the mud with feelings and mudskippers!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Make it stop, sir!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: My mustache! My beautiful musta— (A mudskipper ends up in his mouth.)

Name: Carl
Dialog: Wait, we're not really stuck. It's our boots, sir!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: You're absolutely right! We gotta strip down to our skivvies and shelter under shack over there.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Wait, where is the sound still coming from?

Name: Young Hick
Dialog: Y'all don' stop now. I'uz jest gittin' goin'!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Baljeet, your perspective will never change if you don't put in a little bit of effort.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Okay, okay. (He makes a square with his fingers over his right eye.) A little to the left and... Uh, there! Hold it!

Name: Candace
Dialog: "Hold it" is right!

Name: Candace
Dialog: There's a new sheriff in town! (looks up to see her seemingly huge brother) Wait, what? Phineas and Ferb, what did you do to me?!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Nothin', Candace. It's just an optical illusion. You're actually back there.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, I don't like these optics! I'm still telling Mom! (lifts up her phone to find there's no signal) How do I not have any bars? This is our backyard!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Perhaps you should try telegraph.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Telegraph? Uggh! Good thing I went to that Morse code camp three summers in a row. (A now seemingly tiny Candace jumps onto the telegraph.) "Boys built old-timey town. No building codes. Get home." (laughs)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, Candace, make sure not to rile the miniature ponies.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hehehe... AHHHHH!!! Why are these miniature ponies so big?!?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: They're in the foreground.

Name: Candace
Dialog: That doesn't even make sense! Ow! Then how did they kick me?!?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mmmm...

Name: Linda
Dialog: Dash, dot, dot, dot, dash, dash. It's a good thing that I worked on that submarine those three summers that Candace was at Morse code camp. "Boys built old-timey..." (sighs) I don't even wanna know.

Name: Bubba Doof
Dialog: (to Perry) Ah tell you what, Lunch... You don't mind if Ah call ya "Lunch", do ya? Now, Ah'mma... Ah'mma call ya "Lunch".

Name: Bubba Doof
Dialog: Oh, that's ma cousin, Heinz. He's from Drusselstein. Ah, he moved to the big city though. Now... Now, me, Ah wuz barn 'n' rayzed in this here swamp, jest a stone's throw away a' two bigger adjacent swamps. So it occurred ta me if Ah could connect all three, Ah kood take over the entire Tri-Swamp Area! Problem is theeze beavers keep bildin' dams a' keep th' three swamps sep'rate. A nuisance! (opens window and yells at beavers building a dam) Yer a nuisance! But you, ma li'l duck buddy, you are wanuva kind. The eatin' kind. A li'l pepper, a li'l paprika.

Name: Perry
Dialog: (sneezes)

Name: Bubba Doof
Dialog: Bless yer heart, Lunch. So Ah bilt a gizmo to trick them beavers inta eatin' their own dams. Behold! Ma beaver-inator! Uh, hey, Ned, Ned, time ta feed th' beavs. C'mon, Ned.

Name: Ned
Dialog: Come an' git it, li'l fellers!

Name: Bubba Doof
Dialog: The gizmo pulls that doohickey, which yanks up that thingamajig, ringin' them tin cans, which've bin precisely tuned to th resonant frequencies of a beaver's brain waves, hypnotizin' them beavers. Look, it's workin' right now.

Name: Ned
Dialog: Now drain them dams lickety-split!

Name: Bubba Doof
Dialog: Ring-a-ding-dong, it works! Functionin' properly! (to "Lunch") Ya see that? Ya see it, right?

Name: Bubba Doof
Dialog: Uh, naw, Ah've bin trap bildin' since Ah wuz nee-hi to a grasshopper. You ain't gittin' outta that one.

Name: Buford
Dialog: This town ain't big enough for the both of us.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: But now it is!

Name: Buford
Dialog: It's workin'! I totally changed your perspective! Draw!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oho! Dead ringer! I reckon Baljeet wins!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Well, winning does take the sting out of the fact that there is obviously a horse out there somewhere with only three shoes.

Name: Bubba Doof
Dialog: Wail, wut do we got here?

Name: Bubba Doof
Dialog: Wail, come on up. Ah'm makin' supper.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, thank you so much. I—Mmmm, what is that wonderful smell?

Name: Major Monogram and Carl
Dialog: Agent P?!?

Name: Bubba Doof
Dialog: Go on, have a taste. (licks) Mmm.

Name: Bubba Doof
Dialog: Go on. Yah, don't be shy.

Name: Bubba Doof
Dialog: Ah suppoz Ah'll tone down the spice fer you city folk.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, no, the more spice, the better! Ooh, maybe spices from, uh, another room. Like, uh, really-hard-to-find spices.

Name: Bubba Doof
Dialog: (leaves) Oh, yeah! Now we're talkin'! A'ight, Ah'll... Ah'll see wut Ah kin rustle up.

Name: Carl
Dialog: But, sir, you can barely handle black pepper.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Quiet, Carl!

Name: Bubba Doof
Dialog: Okay, okay. This took sum rustlin', but Ah found... Hey, wait a sec!! Wut do you city boys think yer doin' with ma city duck?!

Name: Bubba Doof
Dialog: That's ma lunch! Hey! Yer-yer takin' ma lunch!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Well, folks, I do not know about Western cinema, but this Forced Perspective Western Town has been a hoot, which I am just now realizing is a thing.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey! Shouldn't you be ridin' off into the sunset or somethin'?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: The only proper response to that question is, "Yeehaw!"

Name: Bubba Doof
Dialog: Hey, y'all city boys come back here with ma lunch!

Name: Carl
Dialog: (to Agent P) Good thing I asked you to bring that repellent!

Name: Bubba Doof
Dialog: Oh! Oh, no! Nooooooo!

Name: Bubba Doof
Dialog: Curse you, Lunch!!!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Time to bust them sodbusters!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, wow! That was close!

Name: Candace
Dialog: See, Mom? See, Mom? Here, look! I—

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, my gosh! Did you guys build this little Western town?

Name: Linda
Dialog: It's adorable! And it looks so big from down here!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's the forced perspective.

Name: Linda
Dialog: I was gonna make some popcorn. Who wants to watch a movie?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I believe I am in the mood for a Western!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah! Let's do it!

Name: Candace
Dialog: That doesn't even make any sense! (beat) And that's not how forced perspective works!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Are you coming or not?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yes, I'm coming.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Okay, but what about llamas?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: The popcorn is poppin'.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Did you hear what Jeremy said?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Buford, stop eavesdropping!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Ooh, we can confess our deepest darkest secrets and emotions!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Or whatever!
